channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

image.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu

item.title: Heavy polling in second phase panchayat elections for Sarpanch, Ward Panch in Rajasthan
item.description: The highest voter turnout was recorded at 84.37% in Jaipur district’s Rampura Dabri

item.title: On JD(U) 23rd foundation day, party gives credit to Nitish for Bihar’s development
item.description: JD(U) State president pointed out that while the term “Bihari” had become synonymous with contempt and neglect before 2005, Nitish Kumar, through his efforts, restored honour and self-respect to Bihar and its people

item.title: Deeply distressing to see ambulances stranded, students missing classes during convoy movement in Kashmir: Sakina Itoo
item.description: Sakina Ittoo appealed to L-G Sinha “to explore practical traffic management measures that uphold essential security protocols while ensuring uninterrupted passage for ambulances and minimising public inconvenience.”

item.title: 17 NC MLAs issue 15-day ultimatum to address ‘coterie culture’, other issues in party
item.description: Four-hour meeting of the 17 NC legislators in Srinagar comes three days after party vice-president and J&K CM Omar Abdullah expanded the Cabinet, leaving several leaders disgruntled at not being given a berth

item.title: GSLV places next-generation navigation satellite NVS-03 into orbit
item.description: The NVS-03, with a mission life of 12 years, is expected to restore the functioning of the NavIC constellation; satellite carries an indigenous atomic clock, along with procured atomic clocks

item.title: Failed relationships cannot turn consensual sex into rape: Supreme Court
item.description: Court distinguishes between consent allegedly obtained through deception and regret over consensual intimacy after a relationship ends

item.title: Election Commission’s appeals against 16.10 lakh cleared voters raise legal questions
item.description: The officials who filed appeals against the inclusion of the 16.10 lakh voters may not have had the authority to do so under the Representation of the People Act; according to the Act, the CEO/DEO/ERO/AERO are the authorities with respect to electoral rolls

item.title: Supreme Court asks Centre to take measures against online misuse of court feeds
item.description: Solicitor General Tushar Mehta submits that suggestions from various High Courts and other stakeholders have been received and forwarded to the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

item.title: Why is ISRO’s NVS-03 satellite launch crucial? | Explained
item.description: The mission could help restore the functioning of India’s regional satellite navigation system NavIC; its development began following the 1999 Kargil War, when the U.S reportedly clamped down on GPS data access

item.title: Haryana BJP MLA questions party’s merit-based jobs policy, warns of anti-incumbency
item.description: The BJP has consistently projected its policy of providing jobs without political recommendations or bribes as one of its biggest achievements in Haryana

item.title: Bihar’s interests must be considered in the Ganga Water Treaty: Samrat Choudhary
item.description: The CM mentioned that Bihar’s rivers hold immense potential for the State, and through the proper management of their water and silt, new opportunities can be created in agriculture, industry, infrastructure, and employment

item.title: TNUHDB identifies 20 sites for reconstruction across State; appeals to residents of dilapidated tenements to vacate
Bengaluru needs long-term master plan for water, roads and sewerage: KBG
item.description: The Minister said a uniform policy would hold agencies excavating roads accountable for restoration, with clear standards, cost recovery and penalties for violations.

item.title: Seven packaged drinking water units closed for violations in Karnataka
item.description: 102 units inspected in two days; 69 water samples collected for laboratory analysis

item.title: Karnataka High Court to nominate new head for SIT to probe KPSC irregularities on Monday
item.description: State government issues notification declaring SIT as police station

item.title: Japan’s Omron Healthcare opens first India manufacturing facility near Chennai
Collector issues directions, appeals to voters and employers ahead of GVMC poll
CM writes to PM seeking revision of sugar MSP, order on ethanol production
item.description: The farmers are awaiting an assurance from the Centre even as the cane crushing season has been delayed amidst prospects of cane yield getting reduced this year due to drought: CM

item.title: Rajyotsava awards to 71 achievers
GBA to launch “Ward One” drive across 43 wards on November 1
596 polling stations set up for civic body polls in Guntur on November 1
item.description: In total, 7,75,803 voters to exercise their franchise in Guntur and Tenali; votes to be counted at Acharya Nagarjuna University for Guntur and VSR College for Tenali on November 3

item.title: Two friends, same police batch: Karnataka loses second officer in two months
U.P. CM prioritised his home turf over 2 Varanasi seats in MLC polls: Akhilesh
item.description: As per the final tally, declared on Thursday afternoon, of the 11 U.P. Legislative Council seats that went to the polls on October 23, the BJP won six while the SP raised its tally from the previous MLC polls by two

item.title: Moderate rain likely in south coastal Andhra Pradesh for three days
item.description: Low-pressure area over Andaman Sea is likely to concentrate into a depression over Bay of Bengal around October 31 and move towards A.P. coast in the next two days, says IMD

item.title: NVS-03 launched successfully; satellite placed in intended orbit | LIVE
item.description: NVS-03 satellite is equipped with an indigenous atomic clock alongside procured atomic clocks

item.title: Andhra Pradesh to spend ₹3,000 crore on irrigation drain modernisation in Godavari region
item.description: Modernisation of irrigation drains will offer a permanent solution to crop inundation problems, says Chief Minister, adding that 4.68 TMC of rainwater has been diverted to reservoirs during Cyclone Arnab

item.title: “Home Nursing Aid” course for geriatric care
MIDS professor Kalaiyarasan’s colleagues condemn police harassment
Supreme Court seeks report from ECI on Form 7 misuse allegations
item.description: Election Commission says it did not accept any Form 7s filed in violation of norms in U.P.; poll officials took prompt corrective steps, it says after Congress MP alleges widespread fraud during SIR

item.title: VIS-Under-15 Football Tournament’s Grand Finale on October 31
item.description: The tournament carries a prize purse of ₹2.25 lakh

item.title: Leased forest land at Athirappilly in Keralam to be surveyed amid disputes over blocking elephant corridor
item.description: Forest department strongly opposes Plantation Corporation, Kerala’s proposal to renew the lease agreement and access more land, citing violation of lease conditions, including engaging private agencies for pineapple farming on the holding

item.title: Crime Branch nabs PSC additional secretary R. Hari in examination irregularities case
item.description: R. Hari and P. Satheesh, a former deputy secretary of the PSC, were allegedly in charge of the evaluation process of the controversial exam to the State Planning Board. Satheesh was arrested recently and Hari had been absconding since

item.title: U.P. CEO directs officials on accurate, error-free and up-to-date maintaining of electoral rolls
item.description: No officer should share their login credentials, such as user ID, login password and OTP, with any other person, directs Uttar Pradesh Chief Electoral Officer

item.title: Tasmac revises liquor prices from November 1, links refund to bottle returns
item.description: Environment cess to be added to the existing maximum retail price of Indian Made Foreign Liquor, beer, wine, liquor from other States and imported liquor; those who return the bottles will get a refund of ₹10

item.title: 108 students found consuming liquor at Chevella farmhouse, four test positive for ganja
BIS organises MSME conclave in Ranipet
item.description: The programme aimed to strengthen awareness among MSMEs regarding standardization, product quality, certification requirements, and the financial and technical assistance available to facilitate compliance with Indian Standards

item.title: Orders issued on Vigilance probe into KIIFB-financed land acquisition in Kannur
item.description: Move follows Cabinet nod for VACB probe based on panel report. Procedural lapses alleged in land acquisitions for Kannur industrial zones, where 4,896 acres were bought for ₹12,240 crore amid questions of due diligence, compliance with LARR Act.

item.title: Man held for possession of 22 country-made explosives in Ranipet
item.description: He was lodged in Central Prison in Vellore

item.title: PCI shocked at inclusion of senior journalist in search warrant requests
item.description: “PCI condemns all attempts by State authorities to intimidate and harass journalists who are reporting on the ongoing protests against the Siang dam project,” read the statement

item.title: Villagers protest against unregulated silt extraction from irrigation tank
item.description: Spread over 25 acres, Pavoor tank is one of the oldest irrigation tanks in the region

item.title: CMC observes World Stroke Day
item.description: Interactive stalls, talks in four languages, testimonies from stroke survivors, and a reel-making competition were also held

item.title: BRS govt. fought Miyapur land case in SC, protected it: Harish Rao
item.description: Says Congress Govt. is planning to sell the land now and terms it a disgrace

item.title: Kashmir issue cannot be addressed through security approach alone, requires political engagement: Mirwaiz
item.description: Kashmir chief cleric Mirwaiz Umar Farooq said peace cannot simply be measured by the absence of protests

item.title: Maharaja’s College witnesses high drama as SFI activists question Minister Roji amid convocation meet
item.description: SFI activists allegedly disrupted the meet soon after the Minister completed his inaugural address seeking answers from him about the suspension of 16 students of Sanskrit varsity, Kalady

item.title: Will not enforce circular on hospital medicine price disclosure for now: Karnataka government to HC
item.description: The circular mandates that all hospital pharmacies disclose the landing base/purchase price and maximum retail price of medicines, medical devices and consumables on bills.

item.title: Senior advocate Ancha Pandu Ranga Rao sworn in as APERC member
item.description: Ancha Pandu Ranga Rao has over three decades of experience practising before Andhra Pradesh High Court, handling writ petitions, civil and criminal cases

item.title: J&K High Court seeks status on retrieval of Pakistan-born son of Indian deported after Pahalgam attack
item.description: Scores of Pakistan-born citizens, married to citizens of J&K, were deported from the Union Territory after the Pahalgam attack, which left 26 civilians dead

item.title: Over 2,200 police drafted for Tirupati election duty across five urban bodies
Bursting of firecrackers only between 8 p.m. and 10 p.m., says Minister
Free child-care training programme for women in Visakhapatnam
Man, accused of secretly filming woman on Namma Metro, questioned
item.description: A police officer investigating the case told The Hindu that the accused had obtained anticipatory bail but had been directed by the magistrate to cooperate with the investigation.

item.title: Air Marshal Inderpal Singh Walia named next IAF Vice Chief
item.description: Air Marshal Walia headed the Directorate of Air Staff Inspection (DASI) of the IAF, served as the defence attache at Indian embassies in Japan and South Korea, and was the Senior Air Staff Officer of Eastern Air Command.

item.title: Kavitha blames BRS, Congress for Adilabad’s irrigation woes; accuses BJP of neglecting CCI plant revival
Citizens for Democracy holds mock Parliament on 'Democracy vs Anarchy'
item.description: Young participants took on the roles of prominent political leaders to debate recent political developments. They enacted parliamentary proceedings, portraying leaders from both the ruling side and the Opposition

item.title: Repairs on cyclone-damaged airport road begins
Two held over death of cheetah; firearm as yet untraced
item.description: Officials suspect that the weapon used in the shooting is “a country-made bharmar gun”, a traditional single-shot, muzzle-loading smoothbore firearm that is popular is the rural and forest parts of the region.

item.title: IIT Dharwad hosting classical music concerts tonight
BJP leaders rationalising Chinese actions, says Congress after Arunachal CM’s remarks
item.description: Congress leader Jairam Ramesh says Mr. Khandu’s remarks contradicted his earlier dismissal of reports of Chinese incursions in Taksing and came a week after the ITBP chief confirmed face-offs at several locations in the State

item.title: Over 1.05 lakh persons bound over ahead of local body polls in A.P.
item.description: DGP Harish Kumar Gupta says 2,726 pending NBWs executed and 261 election-related cases registered; police seize liquor worth ₹11.99 lakh and 495 kg of ganja

item.title: Should Director of Collegiate Education be an academic?
item.description: Citing administrative reasons, the government appointed an IAS officer to the post starting in January 2024. However, the faculty say day-to-day operations of the department have been affected owing to delays in decision-making
